title: SeeRF: Learning to See Beyond Fields of View via Generative Image Registration and Fusion
title_zh: SeeRF：通过生成式图像配准与融合学习看视野之外

paragraphs.en: Due to the inherent discrepancies in imaging viewpoints and field-of-view mismatches among multi-modal sensors, existing fusion methods have long struggled to achieve complete scene-level information integration beyond the limitation in sensor fields of view. Consequently, the generated fusion results often contain modality-specific regions and fusion artifacts, limiting the comprehensive representation of scene structures and semantic information. To address this challenge, we propose a generative registration–fusion framework, termed SeeRF. Specifically, it first introduces a deformation generation strategy based on the diffeomorphic stationary velocity field, combined with visual foundation model-guided feature extraction and a coarse-to-fine progressive multi-modal image registration module, to achieve accurate cross-modal flow estimation and generate valid field-of-view masks. Subsequently, the registration module is tightly coupled with the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion, where the cross-modal control encoding module and the control residual feature encoder–decoder mechanism provide effective guidance. By leveraging the powerful prior modeling capability of generative diffusion models, the proposed framework overcomes the limitations imposed by shared fields of view and enables effective completion and natural fusion of non-overlapping field-of-view regions. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets and real-world scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance, validating its effectiveness, superiority, and robustness. The code will be available at https://github.com/XunpengYi/SeeRF.

paragraphs.en: Image fusion is one of the fundamental problems in digital image processing [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Single-modal images are limited by their observation dimensions, resulting in insufficient information representation. In contrast, multi-modal images can integrate complementary information from different modalities through fusion to produce a more comprehensive representation of the scene. Therefore, it has wide applications in fields such as surveillance and security, autonomous driving, and industrial inspection [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] .

paragraphs.en: Infrared and visible image fusion represents a significant subfield of multi-modal image fusion. It seeks to integrate the rich textural details present in visible images with the thermal radiation characteristics captured by infrared imagery, thereby generating a unified and comprehensive scene representation. Nevertheless, the realization of such fusion fundamentally depends on the acquisition of data from both infrared and visible imaging sensors. Owing to inherent differences in sensor configurations and imaging viewpoints, existing methods characterize the problem by noting that source images acquired by multimodal sensors often exhibit substantial parallax [ 9 , 10 ] . Therefore, several studies have attempted to jointly address image registration and fusion [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] to mitigate these challenges. Despite these advances, most existing joint registration–fusion methods primarily focus on correcting spatial misalignment between cross-modal images while assuming that the source images have consistent field-of-view coverage. However, this assumption does not hold under most conditions. Consequently, existing methods must tolerate such field-of-view inconsistencies and often produce degraded fusion results with noticeable artifacts, while failing to preserve complementary cross-modal information across the entire field of view, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . This also compromises the semantic integrity of the fused representation, ultimately hindering the performance of downstream tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 红外与可见光图像融合是多模态图像融合的一个重要子领域。 它旨在将可见光图像中丰富的纹理细节与红外影像捕获的热辐射特性相结合，从而生成统一而全面的场景表征。 然而，实现此类融合从根本上依赖于同时获取红外与可见光成像传感器的数据。 由于传感器配置和成像视点存在固有差异，现有方法指出多模态传感器获取的源图像往往存在显著的视差 [ 9 , 10 ] 。 因此，一些研究尝试联合解决图像配准与融合问题 [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] ，以缓解上述挑战。 尽管取得这些进展，大多数现有的配准—融合联合方法主要侧重于校正跨模态图像之间的空间错位，同时假设源图像具有一致的视场覆盖范围。 然而，该假设在大多数情况下并不成立。 因此，现有方法必须容忍这种视场不一致问题，且往往产生带有明显伪影的退化融合结果，同时无法在整个视场范围内保留互补的跨模态信息，如图 1 所示。 这也损害了融合表征的语义完整性，最终阻碍了下游任务的性能。

paragraphs.en: On the basis of the above observations, considering differences in sensor installation positions, imaging geometry, and device intrinsic parameters, we rethink the challenges associated with data acquired by heterogeneous imaging sensors into two categories: viewpoint misalignment and field-of-view inconsistency. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , viewpoint misalignment introduces spatial displacements that disrupt spatial correspondences between cross-modal images, resulting in edge misalignment and ghosting artifacts. Meanwhile, the issues caused by field-of-view inconsistency become apparent as spatial misalignment is corrected and cross-modal alignment is established. Specifically, field-of-view inconsistency leads to non-overlapping regions and the absence of information from certain modalities, making it difficult for conventional fusion strategies to reliably integrate information in regions not covered by both sensors.
paragraphs.zh: 基于上述观察，并考虑传感器安装位置、成像几何和设备固有参数的差异，我们将异构成像传感器所采集数据带来的挑战重新归纳为两类：视点错位与视场不一致。 如图2所示，视点错位会引入空间位移，破坏跨模态图像之间的空间对应关系，导致边缘错位与鬼影伪影。 与此同时，当空间错位得到纠正并建立跨模态对齐后，视场不一致所引发的问题便会显现出来。 具体而言，视场不一致会导致非重叠区域以及某些模态信息的缺失，使得传统融合策略难以可靠地整合未被两种传感器共同覆盖区域内的信息。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we propose a unified framework for generative image registration and fusion that learns to see information beyond the shared field of view, termed SeeRF. In detail, we first develop a stationary-velocity-field driven multi-modal image registration module (MIR). It synthesizes an invertible deformation field and jointly incorporates a fine-tuned feature extractor and matcher, enabling progressive estimation of the flow field and achieving view alignment. Subsequently, we develop a generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion (MCF). By performing cross-modal guided completion and fusion, the model establishes consistent observations in missing-scene regions and thereby achieves field-of-view alignment. Importantly, MIR and MCF are intrinsically coupled, jointly breaking the limitations of image fusion beyond the fields of view. MIR establishes a geometrically consistent coordinate system and provides registration-confidence masks, thereby laying the foundation for MCF-guided generation. Conversely, MCF exploits its powerful generative and completion capabilities to compensate for the missing correspondences encountered by MIR in absent or non-overlapping regions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively addresses image fusion beyond the field of view perspective, achieving superior performance and robustness across multiple datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了一个用于生成式图像配准与融合的统一框架，该框架能够学习感知共享视野之外的信息，命名为 SeeRF。 具体而言，我们首先开发了一个由平稳速度场驱动的多模态图像配准模块（MIR）。 该模块合成一个可逆的形变场，并联合引入一个微调后的特征提取器与匹配器，从而实现对流场的渐进式估计并达成视野对齐。 随后，我们开发了一个用于多模态补全与融合（MCF）的生成式扩散模块。 通过执行跨模态引导的补全与融合，该模型在缺失场景区域建立一致的观测，从而实现视野对齐。 重要的是，MIR 与 MCF 本质上相互耦合，共同突破了视野之外图像融合的限制。 MIR 建立了几何一致的坐标系并提供配准置信度掩码，从而为 MCF 引导的生成奠定基础。 反过来，MCF 利用其强大的生成与补全能力，补偿 MIR 在缺失或非重叠区域中遇到的对应关系缺失问题。 大量实验结果表明，所提出的方法有效解决了超出视野范围的图像融合问题，在多个数据集上取得了卓越的性能与鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: By fully exploiting the powerful capability of generative diffusion models and combining it with the valid field-of-view mask and the collaborative effect of the registration module, we achieve effective generative completion and fusion of missing information outside the field of view, enabling the model to fully explore and utilize complementary information beyond the shared field of view across sensors.
paragraphs.zh: 通过充分挖掘生成式扩散模型的强大能力，并将其与有效视场掩码及配准模块的协同作用相结合，我们实现了对视场外缺失信息的有效生成式补全与融合，使模型能够充分探索和利用各传感器间共享视场之外的互补信息。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experimental results demonstrate that SeeRF achieves excellent performance in both cross-modal image registration and fusion tasks, and effectively improves the performance of downstream semantic tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 大量实验结果表明，SeeRF 在跨模态图像配准和融合任务中均取得了优异的性能，并有效提升了下游语义任务的性能。

paragraphs.en: Early image fusion methods typically relied on hand-crafted fusion strategies, resulting in inherent limitations in both fusion effectiveness and generalization capability. With the development of deep learning, image fusion has achieved substantial advances in both methodological frameworks and technical capabilities. Initially, the autoencoder-based image fusion methods were proposed to achieve feature-level fusion by using encoders and decoders pretrained on large-scale datasets, together with hand-crafted fusion rules [ 14 , 15 ] . To overcome the limitations of hand-crafted fusion rules, end-to-end optimization-driven CNN-based methods were subsequently introduced [ 16 ] . These methods optimize similarity-based objectives with respect to the source images, thereby enabling effective integration of complementary source information. Recent architectural advances have provided new impetus for image fusion, leading to the emergence of Transformer-based [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] , diffusion-based [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] , and lookup-table-based methods [ 23 ] that aim to improve fusion quality, model expressiveness, or efficiency. Meanwhile, considerable progress has been achieved in coupling image fusion with its upstream and downstream tasks [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] , ranging from prerequisite image registration to subsequent high-level vision applications.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的图像融合方法通常依赖于手工设计的融合策略，导致融合效果和泛化能力都存在固有的局限性。 随着深度学习的发展，图像融合在方法框架和技术能力方面均取得了显著进展。 最初，研究者提出了基于自编码器的图像融合方法，通过在大规模数据集上预训练的编码器与解码器，结合手工设计的融合规则来实现特征级融合 [ 14 , 15 ] 。 为了克服手工设计融合规则的局限性，随后出现了由端到端优化驱动的基于 CNN 的方法 [ 16 ] 。 这些方法针对源图像优化基于相似性的目标，从而实现互补源信息的有效整合。 近期架构方面的进展为图像融合注入了新的动力，催生了旨在提升融合质量、模型表达能力或效率的基于 Transformer 的方法 [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] 、基于扩散模型的方法 [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] 以及基于查找表的方法 [ 23 ] 。 与此同时，在图像融合与其上游和下游任务的耦合方面也取得了长足进展 [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] ，涵盖从前置的图像配准到后续的高层视觉应用。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate image misregistration arising from intrinsic discrepancies in multi-modal imaging systems, such as variations in acquisition positions, integrated registration-and-fusion methods have been proposed. RFNet [ 9 ] integrates style transfer with a stage-wise registration and fusion framework to progressively compensate for parallax-induced spatial misalignment and produce geometrically aligned fused images. Also, UMF-CMGR [ 27 ] couples GAN-based cross-modal translation with a multi-level registration and fusion mechanism to facilitate reliable correspondence estimation between initially misaligned multi-modal images. Subsequently, C2RF [ 28 ] leverages commonality mining and contrastive learning to achieve image decomposition and fusion, while also adapting to subtle geometric deformations. Furthermore, MulFS-CAP [ 12 ] introduces a learnable modality dictionary and exploits a correlation matrix to jointly perform image registration and fusion in an end-to-end unified framework. FusionRegister [ 29 ] follows a strategy that first performs image fusion and subsequently refines severely misaligned regions via targeted correspondence correction, leading to enhanced fusion performance. Despite considerable progress in registration-based image fusion, existing methods remain unable to resolve field-of-view inconsistencies. It further leads to bottlenecks in both visual appearance and semantic information during fusion, thereby limiting the practical applicability of existing methods.
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解多模态成像系统因采集位置变化等固有差异导致的图像配准偏差，研究者提出了一体化的配准与融合方法。 RFNet [ 9 ] 将风格迁移与分阶段的配准和融合框架相结合，逐步补偿视差引起的空间错位，生成几何上对齐的融合图像。 此外，UMF-CMGR [ 27 ] 将基于生成对抗网络的跨模态翻译与多层次配准融合机制相结合，以便在初始错位的多模态图像之间实现可靠对应关系估计。 随后，C2RF [ 28 ] 利用共性挖掘和对比学习实现图像分解与融合，同时能够适应细微的几何形变。 此外，MulFS-CAP [ 12 ] 引入可学习的模态字典并利用相关矩阵，在端到端的统一框架中联合执行图像配准与融合。 FusionRegister [ 29 ] 遵循先进行图像融合、随后通过针对性对应关系校正来精修严重错位区域的策略，从而提升了融合性能。 尽管基于配准的图像融合已取得长足进展，现有方法仍无法解决视场不一致的问题。 这进一步导致融合过程中在视觉外观和语义信息两方面出现瓶颈，从而限制了现有方法的实际应用。

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details: We implement the SeeRF with the PyTorch [ 32 ] in the machine with four NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs. The optimizer is AdamW [ 33 ] with a learning rate of 0.0001. For the image registration task, the batch size is 8 and the number of epochs is 800. For the image fusion task, gradient accumulation is used with an effective batch size of 16, and the number of epochs is 400. paragraphs.en: Datasets: To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we conduct extensive experiments on widely used infrared and visible image fusion datasets, including MFNet [ 34 ] , FMB [ 35 ] , and LLVIP [ 36 ] datasets. For the MFNet dataset, we utilize 784 infrared–visible image pairs for training and 393 pairs for testing and evaluation. For the FMB dataset, 1220 image pairs are used for training, while 280 pairs are reserved for testing. Similarly, for the LLVIP dataset, we employ 1973 image pairs for training and 432 pairs for testing. For deformation generation, we synthesize geometric transformations using homographic transformations and elastic deformations. Specifically, the rotation angle of the homographic transformation is sampled from [ − 4 ∘ , 4 ∘ ] [-4^{\circ},4^{\circ}] , while the horizontal and vertical translations are constrained to 8% of the image width and height, respectively. For an image of size of 640 × 480 640\times 480 , these constraints correspond to maximum displacements of approximately 51 pixels horizontally and 38 pixels vertically. For elastic deformation, the displacement components along both the horizontal and vertical directions are bounded by 5 pixels. Additionally, we conduct experiments on real-world datasets to demonstrate the practicality of the proposed method. Through experiments on relatively comprehensive datasets, the performance of the method can be effectively verified.

paragraphs.en: Metric: We adopt a comprehensive set of evaluation metrics to thoroughly assess the performance of both registration and fusion. For the cross-modal image registration, we employ the end-point error (EPE) [ 37 ] metric to evaluate the accuracy of the estimated flow correspondence, which directly measures the displacement error between the predicted and ground-truth flow fields. Additionally, mean absolute error (MAE), mutual information (MI) [ 38 ] , correlation coefficient (CC) [ 39 ] , and structural similarity index (SSIM) [ 40 ] are used to evaluate the quality of the registered images by comparing them with the ground-truth images. Among these metrics, lower EPE and MAE values indicate better registration accuracy, whereas higher MI, CC, and SSIM values correspond to more precise image alignment. For the image fusion, we employ standard deviation (SD), visual information fidelity (VIF) [ 41 ] , correlation coefficient (CC), edge information preservation metric Q A ​ B / F Q^{AB/F} [ 42 ] , and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) metrics to evaluate the quality of the fused images. Note that all metrics are evaluated using the full-field-of-view source images that cover the entire scene. SD, VIF, CC, Q A ​ B / F Q^{AB/F} , and SSIM are all metrics where larger values indicate better fused image quality.
paragraphs.zh: 评价指标：我们采用一套全面的评价指标来深入评估配准与融合的性能。 对于跨模态图像配准，我们采用端点误差（EPE）[37]指标来评估估计的流对应关系的准确性，该指标直接衡量预测流场与真实流场之间的位移误差。 此外，还使用平均绝对误差（MAE）、互信息（MI）[38]、相关系数（CC）[39]和结构相似性指数（SSIM）[40]，通过与真实图像进行比较来评估配准图像的质量。 在这些指标中，较低的EPE和MAE值表示更好的配准精度，而较高的MI、CC和SSIM值对应更精确的图像对齐。 对于图像融合，我们采用标准差（SD）、视觉信息保真度（VIF）[41]、相关系数（CC）、边缘信息保持度量 Q^{AB/F} [42]以及结构相似性指数度量（SSIM）来评估融合图像的质量。 请注意，所有指标均使用覆盖整个场景的全视场源图像进行评估。 SD、VIF、CC、Q^{AB/F}和SSIM都是数值越大表示融合图像质量越好的指标。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Results on Image Registration: To provide a more comprehensive evaluation of image registration performance, we visualize the gradient features of the visible images and overlay them onto the registered infrared images for qualitative analysis. The registration quality is assessed from two perspectives: first, the structural similarity between the registered infrared images and the ground-truth infrared images; second, the spatial consistency between salient infrared edges and visible-image gradient responses. A registration method is considered more accurate when the registered results preserve higher structural and detailed consistency with the ground truth while exhibiting stronger spatial correspondence between infrared edge regions and visible gradients, indicating more precise cross-modal spatial alignment. The visualization results are presented in Fig. 6 . In the first scene, benefiting from the effective cross-modal registration design, SeeRF accurately aligns the human targets and road edge structures, demonstrating superior registration performance. In contrast, existing competing methods suffer from varying degrees of registration errors, leading to noticeable misalignment in target regions. Such discrepancies are particularly evident in critical structural areas, including human contours and road boundaries, where substantial spatial deviations can be observed. Similarly, in the second and third groups of scenes, CrossRAFT demonstrates relatively strong registration performance in salient regions, including street lamps, vegetation, and vehicles, and is able to establish relatively accurate structural correspondences. However, due to its limited capability in handling complex scenes and boundary regions, its results still exhibit noticeable edge mismatches and local geometric distortions. Constrained by their registration capabilities, UMF-CMGR, MulFS-CAP, and CPMFusion fail to achieve effective alignment in these critical regions, resulting in considerable spatial discrepancies. Although SuperFusion and AUNet can capture certain cross-modal structural consistencies, they still suffer from local misalignment, indicating that their registration accuracy remains suboptimal. In comparison, the proposed method achieves the best performance in both fine-grained object alignment and global spatial consistency.

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Results on Image Fusion: The corresponding qualitative visualization results are presented in Fig. 7 . Our method exhibits two significant advantages. First, SeeRF is able to generate more complete and natural fused scenes. Owing to the field-of-view discrepancy between infrared and visible sensors, certain target regions in the registered images may appear in only one modality, which causes existing methods to suffer from information loss, structural discontinuities, and unnatural visual transitions during the fusion process. For instance, in the first scene, part of the infrared information of the pedestrian within the purple box is missing. As most competing methods lack effective generative completion capability, they tend to produce obvious one-sided missing artifacts. Similarly, in non-overlapping field-of-view regions involving structures such as vehicle exhaust pipes, tires, road surfaces, handlebars, and feet, existing methods struggle to adequately model cross-modal field-of-view relationships, often resulting in structural omissions and fusion artifacts. In contrast, by combining an accurate cross-modal registration strategy with a diffusion-based generative fusion mechanism, SeeRF can effectively learn and recover information from non-overlapping field-of-view regions. As a result, it restores more complete target structures while maintaining spatial consistency, thereby producing fused results that are more natural, continuous, and visually coherent. Second, SeeRF can generate clearer visual representations while effectively preserving key structures and detailed information from the source images. In the fence region of the first scene and the high-voltage transmission tower region of the third scene, most comparison methods fail to sufficiently preserve texture details and color information from the visible images, while also losing structural edge features of the high-voltage transmission tower, thereby reducing the overall visual quality and scene representation capability of the fused results. In contrast, SeeRF achieves a better balance among texture details, color information, and infrared thermal radiation features during the fusion process, producing high-quality fusion results with clear structures, natural colors, and prominent thermal target information.

paragraphs.en: Object Detection: For the object detection task, we employ YOLOv11 1 1 1 https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics as the evaluation backbone and initialize it with pretrained weights. For the fused images produced by each image fusion method, the object detector is retrained on the corresponding datasets to ensure a fair comparison. The qualitative and quantitative results are presented in Fig. 10 and Tab. V , respectively. From a qualitative perspective, constrained by limited viewpoint alignment and field-of-view correspondence capabilities, almost all competing methods suffer from missed detections. Moreover, U2Fusion, MURF, and SuperFusion produce duplicate detections and false positives in some sets of results. In contrast, the proposed method achieves the most comprehensive detection performance, demonstrating superior scene representation capability. From a quantitative perspective, the proposed SeeRF consistently achieves the best performance across all evaluation metrics, including Precision, Recall, mAP@50, and mAP@50:95. Compared with the second-best performing method, U2Fusion, SeeRF obtains improvements of 0.038, 0.031, 0.057, and 0.054 in Precision, Recall, mAP@50, and mAP@50:95, respectively. These results clearly demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in facilitating downstream semantic segmentation tasks.

sents.en: Moreover, U2Fusion, MURF, and SuperFusion produce duplicate detections and false positives in some sets of results.

paragraphs.en: General Experiments: To comprehensively validate the effectiveness of each proposed component, we conduct a series of ablation studies and systematically analyze the contribution of individual components from both image registration and image fusion perspectives. For the MIR, we conduct ablation experiments by removing the foundation model (DINOv3) Guidance mechanism (w/o FMG), replacing the proposed diffeomorphic deformation generation strategy with a conventional random elastic deformation generation method (w/o DGS), and substituting the coarse-to-fine progressive flow regression strategy with direct flow prediction (w/o CTF). For the MCF, we individually remove the control residual feature encoder (w/o CRFE), the cross-modal control encoding module (w/o CCE), and the valid field-of-view mask mechanism (w/o VFM). By ablating the valid field-of-view mask (VFM), we disable the guidance for generative completion, enabling a controlled comparison to evaluate the effect of out-of-field content generation. These experiments aim to systematically investigate the contribution of each component to registration accuracy and fusion quality. The results are presented in Fig. 11 and Tab. VI .

VI所示。

Quantitative evaluations further reveal increased in EPE and MAE, accompanied by noticeable declines in MI, CC, and SSIM between the registered and reference images. These results demonstrate the necessity of each proposed component for accurate displacement field modeling, effective cross-modal structural alignment, and improved registration quality.

These results further validate the critical contributions of the proposed components in improving fusion quality and enhancing the generative capability of the framework.

paragraphs.en: From the qualitative results, the absence of modality-specific information in non-overlapping field-of-view regions and the resulting unnatural fusion discontinuities negatively affect the completeness of scene semantic representation. Specifically, the bump target within the red box exhibits obvious structural truncation in the segmentation results, failing to preserve its complete semantic contour. Meanwhile, the corresponding fusion visualization also exhibits poor visual continuity and representation quality. These observations indicate that information loss caused by field-of-view inconsistency not only degrades the visual quality of fused images but also compromises the structural integrity of objects, thereby affecting the accurate recognition and complete representation of targets in downstream semantic segmentation tasks. Similarly, removing either CRFE or CCE impairs the model’s ability to capture fine-grained features and effectively integrate multimodal information, consequently degrading its performance on downstream semantic segmentation tasks. These findings further substantiate the motivation behind our approach and demonstrate the important contributions of CRFE and CCE to improving fusion quality and enhancing semantic representation for downstream tasks.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the feasibility of full-field-of-view image fusion, we independently assess the similarity between the generated content in non-overlapping field-of-view regions and the corresponding ground-truth images from the original modalities. Given the nature of this similarity assessment task, we adopt evaluation metrics similar to those used for image registration and additionally include peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) to quantify the fidelity of the generated content. In the setting where infrared information is missing, poor metric values indicate that the generated regions either lack meaningful infrared information or fail to faithfully represent the actual infrared scene. Conversely, stronger similarity between the generated content and the ground-truth scene corresponds to better metric performance. Accordingly, higher MI, CC, PSNR, and SSIM values indicate more reliable and accurate generation, whereas a lower MAE indicates smaller reconstruction errors and better generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估全视野图像融合的可行性，我们独立评估非重叠视野区域内生成内容与原始模态对应真值图像之间的相似性。 鉴于该相似性评估任务的性质，我们采用与图像配准类似的评估指标，并额外引入峰值信噪比（PSNR）来量化生成内容的保真度。 在红外信息缺失的设置下，较差的指标值表明生成区域要么缺乏有意义的红外信息，要么未能忠实呈现实际的红外场景。 反之，生成内容与真值场景之间更强的相似性对应更好的指标表现。 因此，更高的 MI、CC、PSNR 和 SSIM 值表明生成结果更可靠、更准确，而更低的 MAE 则表明重建误差更小、生成质量更好。

paragraphs.en: In real-world scenarios, existing methods exhibit two major limitations. (1) Limited registration capability. Some competing methods struggle to establish accurate cross-modal correspondences, leaving substantial spatial misalignment in the registered results and failing to adequately compensate for target displacements caused by temporal offsets between sensor acquisitions. Specifically, FusionReg and MulFS-CAP fail to achieve effective spatial alignment across all presented scenes, exhibiting pronounced registration failures. CPMFusion, SuperFusion, and AUNet achieve partial improvements in cross-modal alignment; however, noticeable stretching and geometric distortions persist near image boundaries, compromising the overall visual quality of the fused results. Among the competing methods, CrossRAFT, denoted as Reg. , demonstrates relatively strong registration performance, achieving reasonable spatial alignment in most scenes, although noticeable misalignment remains in certain boundary regions. By comparison, SeeRF achieves more accurate alignment of both target regions and image boundaries, substantially reducing local misalignment and implausible geometric distortions, thereby delivering superior overall registration performance. (2) Field-of-view inconsistency. All competing methods fail to effectively recover missing information in non-overlapping field-of-view regions. Notably, the limitations imposed by field-of-view discrepancies become even more apparent when accurate spatial alignment has been achieved. Although some methods successfully align the overlapping regions, they fail to adequately recover targets, such as pedestrians and vehicles, located in non-overlapping regions. Consequently, the fused images exhibit pronounced structural discontinuities and unnatural transitions between observed and missing regions. These artifacts compromise the integrity of target-level semantic structures and reduce overall scene fidelity, ultimately limiting the representational capacity of the fused images. In contrast, by leveraging the powerful prior modeling and content completion capabilities of generative diffusion models, SeeRF effectively reconstructs missing content in non-overlapping field-of-view regions and seamlessly integrates the generated content with the observed regions. This enables the generation of more complete and coherent fused images with improved scene representation capability.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the computational efficiency of the proposed method, we report the number of model parameters, computational complexity (FLOPs), and inference time. Since our fusion process is built upon a diffusion model, we further decompose the entire framework into individual components and analyze their detailed parameter counts and computational costs, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of the resource consumption of each module. The results are reported in Tab. IX . It can be observed that, for the MIR registration component (SeeRF-Reg.), although a visual foundation model is incorporated, the overall computational cost remains acceptable, with 113.367M parameters, 437.667G FLOPs, and an inference time of 0.142s. For the MCF fusion component (SeeRF-Fus.), the overall network is built upon the diffusion model. To preserve strong generative capability, it inevitably introduces higher computational costs, with 1701.765M parameters, 1968.819G FLOPs, and an inference time of 5.293s.

paragraphs.en: To achieve superior registration and fusion performance, we incorporate visual foundation models with strong representation capabilities and diffusion models as the backbone components of our framework. Although these models substantially improve task performance, they inevitably introduce increased computational complexity and inference overhead. Despite employing sampling acceleration strategies to alleviate the computational burden during inference, the proposed architecture still leaves room for further lightweighting and optimization. Future research may explore more efficient generative paradigms, such as single-step generation or flow matching, to reduce computational and memory requirements while preserving the effectiveness of the proposed framework, thereby facilitating its deployment in real-world applications.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现卓越的配准与融合性能，我们将具有强大表征能力的视觉基础模型和扩散模型作为我们框架的主干组件。 尽管这些模型显著提升了任务性能，但它们不可避免地带来了更高的计算复杂度和推理开销。 尽管采用了采样加速策略来缓解推理过程中的计算负担，所提出的架构仍有进一步轻量化和优化的空间。 未来的研究可以探索更高效的生成范式，例如单步生成或流匹配，以在保持所提框架有效性的同时降低计算与内存需求，从而促进其在实际应用中的部署。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose a generative registration and fusion framework, termed SeeRF, which aims to overcome the long-standing limitation of shared fields of view in image fusion. It addresses the long-standing issue in image registration and fusion, where existing methods primarily rely on information alignment and fusion within overlapping shared field-of-view regions while neglecting the complementary information contained in sensor-specific regions, resulting in missing information or residual artifacts in non-shared field-of-view regions. Specifically, SeeRF first performs flow field estimation and generates valid field-of-view masks through a diffeomorphic stationary velocity field-based deformation generation strategy, combined with a vision foundation model-guided feature extraction mechanism and a coarse-to-fine progressive multi-modal image registration module. Subsequently, the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion is tightly coupled with the multi-modal image registration module, leveraging powerful generative capabilities to overcome the shared field-of-view constraint and achieve effective modeling and fusion of non-shared field-of-view information. Extensive experiments on public datasets and real-world data demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种生成式配准与融合框架，称为 SeeRF，旨在克服图像融合中共享视野的长期限制。 它解决了图像配准与融合中的长期问题：现有方法主要依赖于重叠共享视野区域内的信息对齐与融合，而忽视了传感器特有区域所包含的互补信息，导致非共享视野区域出现信息缺失或残留伪影。 具体而言，SeeRF 首先进行流场估计，并通过基于微分同胚稳态速度场的形变生成策略，结合视觉基础模型引导的特征提取机制以及由粗到精的渐进式多模态图像配准模块，生成有效的视野掩膜。 随后，用于多模态补全与融合的生成式扩散模块与多模态图像配准模块紧密耦合，利用强大的生成能力克服共享视野约束，实现对非共享视野信息的有效建模与融合。 在公开数据集和真实数据上的大量实验证明了所提方法的有效性和优越性。
